text:
```yaml
name: Windows Installer Build

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-windows-installer:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up MSYS2
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: MINGW64
          install: >-
            base-devel
            mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python3
            mingw-w64-x86_64-pkg-config
          update: true

      - name: Provision MSYS2
        run: |
          ./provision-msys2.sh
        shell: msys2 {0}

      - name: Build OpenPLC Runtime
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. -G "MinGW Makefiles"
          make
        shell: msys2 {0}

      - name: Download Inno Setup
        run: |
          curl -L -o InnoSetup.exe https://files.jrsoftware.org/is/6/innosetup-6.2.2.exe
          InnoSetup.exe /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /NORESTART /SP-
        shell: cmd

      - name: Build installer with Inno Setup
        run: |
          "C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe" /O"dist" "setup.iss"
        shell: cmd

      - name: Upload installer to GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          files: dist/*.exe
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
